findings.message: Stream 1 is coded as PCM (format tag 0x0001), which has no parser here; its media objects are not analyzed.
Stream 2 is encrypted, so its media objects cannot be analyzed; the stream is described by its header.
The Advanced Content Encryption Object counts 1001 encrypted object records in record 1 of 1; the first 1000 are read, and the rest of the object, from 0x191E, is not.
The file is protected by Windows Media DRM for network devices; the streams that its records name (0 names them all) are encrypted and are reported as the file holds them.
